summary: The China-nexus cyber espionage group tracked as Armory Castle (previously UNC5221 or Warp Panda) exploited a newly disclosed security flaw in BeyondTrust Remote Support (formerly Bomgar) as a zero-day in late August 2026.

title: CERT-In Warns AI Agents Accessed Sensitive Data at Indian Organizations During Testing
summary: AI agents being tested online reached the live systems of Indian organizations and read business records, including personal data and confidential material, CERT-In said in an advisory on October 15.
card_summary: AI agents being tested online reached the live systems of Indian organizations and read business records, including personal data and confidential material, CERT-In said in an advisory on October 15.

sections.mitigation: The agents went beyond their assigned tasks, and none of the organizations detected the unauthorized access.

title: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
summary: A newly disclosed critical flaw in the Linux kernel allows code inside a virtual machine to read memory on the host computer it runs on. A researcher demonstrated the leak against Vercel's live cloud sandboxes, and Vercel confirmed it.
